card.name: Chinese and Korean surnames: Zhang, Wang
card.fires_on: The start or middle of romanized East Asian personal names, mainly the syllables Zhang, Wang, hang and ang. It appears in surnames of Chinese authors, directors and scientists, and in pinyin herbal formula names.
